description: Data-snooping tests on every variant a search tried: Hansen's SPA p-value that the best beat the benchmark only by luck, White's Reality Check, and the variants Romano-Wolf StepM finds better. Send all variants tried, not only the winners. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

benchmark.description: Benchmark return per period; default zero.

block_length.description: Mean bootstrap block in periods; default round(n^(1/3)).

matrix.description: Returns of every variant the search tried, one row per period, one column per variant.

matrix_file.description: Path to a CSV or JSON with one numeric column per variant, instead of matrix.

name: validate_reality_check

outputSchema.description: data.result holds the statistics (data.plain_reading states them); limits say what the result does not establish; receipt ({id, url}) is the signed record, null when none was stored; error ({code, message}) is set only on refusal.

title: Data-snooping tests (SPA, Reality Check, StepM)
